Requirements: R-10
Plan row: TS-3

Obligations: OB-4.

## Given
- Projects A and B environments by the acting user, each holding one MS Teams integration.

## When
1. PUT A's MS Teams integration with project_name = B.
2. List the MS Teams integrations of A and of B.

## Then
1. P-occupied: the PUT is rejected with a 4xx (conflict or validation), not 2xx.
2. The rejection reason is not the "Project mismatch" text (so the case cannot pass vacuously while TC-002 is red).
3. B still holds exactly one MS Teams integration, its original id.
4. A still holds its own MS Teams integration, unchanged.

## Self-probe notes
- Discriminating input: the target is occupied; an strengthening move would give B two records, visible in Then 3.
- Then 2 separates this rejection from the Q2 a defect. The stated exact status is read from R-10 only as "rejected, no duplicate"; the status code is not pinned beyond 4xx.
- Lists are read independently of the PUT response. After TC-002 passes, a follow-up scenario (source creates a new one once its integration moved away) is a plan scenario and is left to the automator as a second partition P-freed if the stand allows.
